items.title_en: Japanese PM Sanae Takaichi reveals she felt 'lonely' when staff exterminated residence cockroach
items.title_zh: 日本首相高市早苗透露，当工作人员消灭住宅蟑螂时，她感到“孤独”
items.summary_en: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi has sparked widespread amusement and disbelief after admitting that she felt "a little lonely" when her aides stepped in to remove a cockroach from her official residence. The bizarre confession came during a series of candid late-night posts on X (formerly Twitter), where Takaichi was defending her routine of spending long, solitary hours working from the historic Tokyo residence—known locally as the kotei .
